title: Incremental minimization problem for fatigue debonding
statement:
For each $i\in\mathbb{N}$, find $(v_i,\delta_i)$ such that
\[
E_i(v_i)=\min_{v\in V_i}E_i(v),
\qquad
\delta_i=\delta_{i-1}+\langle v_i-v_{i-1}\rangle,
\]
with $v_0=\delta_0=0$, where
\[
V_i=\{v\in W^{1,2}(0,L):v(0)=0,\ v\ge 0,\ v(L)=V_i\}
\]
and
\[
E_i(v)=\frac{N}{2}\int_0^L v'(s)^2\,ds+\int_0^L\gamma\!\left(\delta_{i-1}(s)+\langle v(s)-v_{i-1}(s)\rangle\right)\,ds.
\]
